Per-user acceptance record for a reference agreement; 4-column composite PK. No history table.


[cols="2,2,1,3",role=sortable]
|===
| Column | Type | Null | Default / Key
| `reference_id` | `UUID` | N | PK, FK
| `reference_agreement_id` | `UUID` | N | PK, FK
| `user_id` | `UUID` | N | PK, FK
| `acceptance_timestamp` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | N | PK, DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
|===

*Foreign keys:*
** (`reference_id`, `reference_agreement_id`) -> `reference_configuration`(`reference_id`, `reference_agreement_id`)
** `user_id` -> `users`(`id`)

*Composite primary key:* (`reference_id`, `reference_agreement_id`, `user_id`, `acceptance_timestamp`)

*History shadow:* none.

=== `demos_app.reference_configuration`

Configuration controlling reference visibility / lifecycle by status.


[cols="2,2,1,3",role=sortable]
|===
| Column | Type | Null | Default / Key
| `id` | `UUID` | N | 
| `reference_id` | `UUID` | N | UK, FK
| `reference_agreement_id` | `UUID` | Y | FK
| `status_id` | `TEXT` | N | FK
|===

*Foreign keys:*
** `reference_id` -> `reference`(`id`)
** `reference_agreement_id` -> `reference_agreement`(`id`)
** `status_id` -> `reference_configuration_status`(`id`)

*Composite unique indexes:*
** (`reference_id`, `reference_agreement_id`) (`reference_configuration_reference_id_reference_agreement_id_key`)

*History shadow:* `reference_configuration_history` (`revision_id`, `revision_type`, `modified_at` + the parent columns mirroring nullability).

== On-demand reports

=== `demos_app.on_demand_report`

Net-new in DEMOS. An on-demand generated report stored in S3; carries the requesting user, report type, and status. No history table.


[cols="2,2,1,3",role=sortable]
|===
| Column | Type | Null | Default / Key
| `id` | `UUID` | N | 
| `s3_path` | `TEXT` | N | 
| `requesting_user_id` | `UUID` | N | FK
| `report_type_id` | `TEXT` | N | FK
| `status_id` | `TEXT` | N | FK
| `report_generated_at` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | N | 
| `generated_file_name` | `TEXT` | N | 
|===

*Foreign keys:*
** `requesting_user_id` -> `users`(`id`)
** `report_type_id` -> `on_demand_report_type`(`id`)
** `status_id` -> `on_demand_report_status`(`id`)

*CHECK constraints:*
** `check_non_empty_s3_path`: `trim(s3_path) != ''`

*History shadow:* none.


== Sessions

=== `demos_app.user_session`

Per-user authentication session counter. One row per (user_id, auth_time); subsequent auth events for the same session bump last_auth_event_time and increment auth_event_count. No history table.


[cols="2,2,1,3",role=sortable]
|===
| Column | Type | Null | Default / Key
| `user_id` | `UUID` | N | FK
| `auth_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | N | 
| `last_auth_event_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | N | 
| `auth_event_count` | `INTEGER` | N | 
|===

*Foreign keys:*
** `user_id` -> `users`(`id`)

*Composite primary key:* (`user_id`, `auth_time`)

*History shadow:* none.
